story.title: Story 1: Attach Repositories to a Project or Process

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 1 end to end by adding source-attachment Fastify routes, a source-management service with GitHub identity/ref validation and duplicate policy, durable project/process attachment persistence in the platform store and Convex, immediate process current-source mutation for process-scoped attaches, and the mapped Story 1 API/service/client/Convex tests.

changedFiles.reason: Wired the new source-management route and service into app construction and Fastify decorations.
Added authenticated project/process source-attachment POST routes with access checks and typed error responses.
Extended store types and implementations to persist project/process source attachments and update in-memory process current-source refs.
Added GitHub repository URL parsing, canonical full-name normalization, and target-ref normalization helpers.
Added the GitHub resolver seam plus Octokit-backed repository/ref/default-branch validation.
Implemented attach orchestration, identity checks, writable-ref policy, duplicate preflight, and persistence error mapping.
Rendered canonical repository identity in the source attachment UI so new attachments show identity immediately.
Added durable create mutations, active duplicate enforcement, project/process timestamp updates, and atomic process current-source mutation.
Added the missing-target-ref duplicate invariant test for durable source attachments.
Updated the client test to assert repository identity and scope visibility for new attachments.
Added Story 1 Fastify boundary tests for project/process attach, duplicate rejection, and invalid/inaccessible repository rejection.
Added pure service-policy tests for identity derivation, mismatch rejection, non-GitHub rejection, writable-ref rules, default-branch resolution, and scope coexistence.

findingsFixed: Added the real Fastify attach boundary instead of leaving Story 1 at shared-contract/schema level.
Enforced exact duplicate protection at both service preflight and durable Convex mutation layers, including null targetRef duplicates.
Made process-scoped attaches immediately current for the owning process by updating current source refs in the same durable path.
Exposed canonical repository identity in the source attachment UI so the created attachment is visibly attributable right away.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand this story to verification for manual attach-flow smoke checks in the project shell and process work surface against a live local runtime.
